judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid and then receives a three-coin commission; nothing in the transcript shows bidding above available coins or that the commission is applied before payment. The model did not articulate a mechanism that would support this claim.

Although the clerk reveals committed rival bids in the transcript, the model did not articulate the mechanism by which waiting reveals others’ sealed bids prior to committing. The specification asserts a mechanism (revealing before you commit) but the model output only shows behavior, not an explanation meeting the discovery standard.

The rules specify that close settles after all three lots are sold; the claim that close settles the game even with unauctioned lots contradicts the rule text and is not supported by the transcript or model articulation.

The rules explicitly state catalog items are not auction wins and the three-coin commission applies to the auction winner; there is no evidence or model articulation that catalog purchases receive the auction commission.
